messages:
maria: FYI - during a spot restore of tenant-42 backups we hit a KMS decrypt failure.
jenna_sec: error?
maria: Cloud restore job failed with: AccessDeniedException: "kms:Decrypt" on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-ef01
raj: did we rotate grants last week? I remember an RBAC cleanup on 2025-11-04
sam_dev: I pushed an IAM role rename on Tuesday that touched backup-uploader-sa
maria: @raj @sam_dev can you confirm whether backup-uploader-sa retained kms:Decrypt grant
jenna_sec: checking cloudtrail -> saw CreateGrant for that key at 2025-11-03T17:02:10Z, principal backup-uploader-sa, grantId g-1234
jenna_sec: then there's a RevokeGrant 2025-11-05T02:12:01Z
kevin_ops: that revoke looks suspicious - it was part of the RBAC prune runbook (ticket #5043)
opsbot: deploy: RBAC-prune completed by automation at 2025-11-05T02:11:58Z :white_check_mark:
maria: so revoke removed grant for backup-uploader-sa mid-retention window, causing restore failures
raj: short-term mitigation: re-create grant for backup-uploader-sa scoped to decrypt only, TTL 6h
raj: command: `aws kms create-grant --key-id abcdef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/backup-uploader-sa --operations Decrypt`
sam_dev: doing that now
sam_dev: created temp grant g-6789, restore job resumed :thumbsup:
maria: confirm restore complete? what's last successful byte count
sam_dev: restore finished, verified checksum, tenant-42 DB restored
jenna_sec: postmortem/next steps:
  - update RBAC prune to skip active grants attached to uploader roles
  - add CloudTrail filter alert for RevokeGrant on CMKs used by backups
  - add test in canary for restore after RBAC pruning
  - add playbook snippet for ephemeral grants in runbook
maria: can someone open a doc with steps and TL;DR for oncall? link please
raj: created https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-restore-ephemeral-groups (internal)
kevin_ops: also we should consider a fallback key (cross-account escrow). ops will draft KMS escrow proposal
jenna_sec: I'll file a vuln-triage ticket to review whether RBAC prune rules were too aggressive -> VULN-2025-238
maria: thanks all. @opsbot can you schedule a brief postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT? :calendar:
opsbot: meeting created 2025-11-06 09:30 PT - Postmortem: KMS-grant-revoke-restore
sam_dev: adding a unit test to CI for grant-preservation during role rename
maria: nice. also add a note to encryption runbook about verifying grant lifecycles
raj: noted and will follow up on the playbook PR
